nodes.description: Private address of the fixed external token contract (0x2054a15c6822a722378d13c4e4ea85365e46e50b) used to build tokenReward.
Private address set to msg.sender at deployment; privileged account gating admin() and out().
Private address set to msg.sender inside the payable fallback; used as recipient of payouts.
Private uint256 holding tokenReward.balanceOf(user) for the current caller.
Private uint256 payout amount computed as usertoken * dividends1token + msg.value.
Public constant-like payout rate 3531272953274 multiplying the caller token balance.
Public timestamp 1538352000 used as the payout start gate together with now.
Public mapping(address=>uint256) used as paid-out flag; written after the transfer.
Public mapping(address=>uint256) admin whitelist; admins[msg.sender]=1 in constructor and mutable via admin().
Public token interface instance pointing to maintoken, target of the balanceOf external call.
Constructor: builds tokenReward from maintoken and grants admins[msg.sender]=1.
Payable external fallback: non-admins are recorded, token balance read, then payout or refund via user.transfer.
Privileged setter guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) writing admins[_admin] = _value.
Privileged drain function guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) sending this.balance to owner.
External view interface entry point token.balanceOf(address _owner) returning the token balance.
Caller-supplied address; controls owner init, admin grant, user assignment, payouts and refunds.
now value compared against dividendstart to gate the large payout path.
External value transfer of the computed payout to the caller-controlled user address.
External refund transfer of msg.value to the caller-controlled user address in the else branch.
Drains the entire contract balance to owner in out().
External call into the token contract with caller-influenced argument before state flag update.
State write that grants or revokes admin rights for an arbitrary address.
Unchecked arithmetic computing the payout; multiplication may overflow and inflate userether.
Parameter of admin(address _admin, uint8 _value): address whose admin level is written.
Parameter of admin(address _admin, uint8 _value): admin level stored for _admin.
Parameter of the token interface function balanceOf(address _owner).

edges.reason: owner state variable is initialized directly from msg.sender at deployment.
Constructor grants admins[msg.sender] = 1, giving the deployer caller privileged status.
Fallback assigns user = msg.sender, storing attacker-controlled address.
Fallback flow is driven by the caller: admin branch bypasses payout, non-admin branch proceeds.
admins[msg.sender] != 1 check decides whether the fallback performs the payout logic.
now > dividendstart gates entry into the value-bearing payout branch (timestamp dependency).
Timestamp condition controls execution of the large user.transfer(userether) payout.
user address is passed as the argument to the external token balanceOf call.
tokenReward state variable is the target contract of the balanceOf external call.
Return value of balanceOf is stored in usertoken.
usertoken feeds the multiplication that can overflow.
dividends1token is the large multiplier in the unchecked payout arithmetic.
Overflowing arithmetic result is stored in userether.
Potentially inflated userether amount is transferred to the caller.
Transfer sends funds to the caller-controlled user address before the paid flag is set.
Fallback executes user.transfer(userether) on the payout path prior to updating users[user].
Else path of the fallback refunds msg.value via user.transfer(msg.value).
Refund is sent to the caller-controlled user address.
users[user] = 1 is written only after the external transfer, enabling repeated payouts.
External token call occurs before users[user] is set, so the callee can re-enter the fallback.
out() performs owner.transfer(this.balance) to drain the contract.
owner receives the whole contract balance in out().
admin() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the admin() guard.
out() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
_admin parameter is used as the mapping key when writing admin rights.
_value parameter is written as the admin level in admins mapping.
admin() executes the admins[_admin] = _value privileged state write.
The privileged write mutates the admins mapping consulted by the fallback.
_owner is the address argument consumed by the external token balanceOf interface function.
maintoken address is cast into the token interface stored in tokenReward.
Constructor assigns tokenReward = token(maintoken).
Constructor writes admins[msg.sender] = 1, establishing the deployer as admin.

normalization_plan.reason: _admin is only used as the index of the privileged admins[_admin] = _value state write and carries no independent behaviour.
_value is only used as the stored admin level in the admins[_admin] = _value state write.
_owner is only the address argument of the token interface function balanceOf(address _owner) and has no standalone semantics.
